headline: Lima Annual Inflation Rises to 5.25% in October
summary: Consumer prices in Metropolitan Lima increased 5.25% year-on-year in October 2026, according to statistics institute INEI. The figure marks the highest annual inflation rate in Peru's capital since August 2023.
why: Inflation metrics in Peru's capital heavily influence the Central Reserve Bank of Peru's monetary policy decisions and interest rate trajectory.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation increases expectations that the central bank may keep interest rates elevated.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher-than-expected inflation readings strain consumer purchasing power and reduce expectations of upcoming monetary easing by the central bank.
